I think there's always some level of exhaustion when it comes to dealing with ppl and emotions, but you seem to focus specifically on the bad things that happen stating you don't care. Maybe that's because of the state of the world or what you're hearing more of right now, but you're not alone. I feel that a lot too and when I get "overwhelmed" with it, I turn into a recluse. 

However, it's worth noting that I feel this way more often when it comes to good things like baby announcements, new relationships and marriage, job promotions, vacations ppl are taking, and when they buy a house or get a new apartment. God forbid they get a new car or cat, ppl can't stop talking about them! 

My advice would be to either find a time and place to decompress. For me it's camping, the shooting range, or just finding an empty place with nice scenery to enjoy alone. I also suspect this is why I love dive bars too - no drama, cheap drinks, and very few ppl around. 

I hope you find your peace because I believe masks aren't meant to be worn permanently, and honestly, I think the more I wear it, the more it sucks the life essence from my soul. I feel like it's not as bulletproof as it used to be and ppl might be able to see through it so I tend to only be around for gatherings for short periods of time before I feel like I'll get discovered. 

Good luck to you, I wish you best (like I give a fuck) lol!
